hero.h2: Welcome to Alsharq College for Specialized Technical Sciences
hero.line1: Built on solid academic foundations and continuous alignment with modern technologies,
hero.line2: Alsharq College delivers an integrated, hands-on education that prepares capable graduates for society and the labor market.

greenCard.deanImageAlt: Dean of Alsharq College for Specialized Technical Sciences
greenCard.title: Message from the Dean of Alsharq College for Specialized Technical Sciences
greenCard.name: Dr. Ahmed Abdul Kadhim Al-Amiri
greenCard.role: Dean of Alsharq College for Specialized Technical Sciences
greenCard.intro: Dear visitors, welcome to our website ...
greenCard.p1: It is my pleasure and pride to welcome you to Alsharq College for Specialized Technical Sciences, where we continuously strive to provide advanced technical education that meets the needs of the local and global market, and enhances our students' capabilities to become leaders in their fields.
greenCard.p2: Since its establishment, the College has been committed to equipping students with the latest technical knowledge and skills that enable them to adapt to rapid changes in the world of technology, through advanced academic programs aimed at achieving excellence in education and scientific research. We believe in the importance of integrating theoretical and applied aspects to provide an educational environment that encourages innovation and creativity.
greenCard.p3: As part of our strategic plan, we focus on strengthening partnerships with educational and industrial institutions to provide training and employment opportunities, in addition to developing the infrastructure for education technology and supporting it with modern educational systems that keep pace with best global practices.
greenCard.p4: We are working hard to achieve our strategic goals in providing high-quality education, with a focus on human and professional values that contribute to preparing a generation capable of facing future challenges and effectively contributing to the development of society.
greenCard.p5: We invite you to explore our website for more information about academic programs, activities, and opportunities offered by the College.
greenCard.outro: Together, we work to build a bright future.

programs.title: College Programs
programs.h3: Studying at Alsharq College for Specialized Technical Sciences
programs.p1: Your educational journey at Alsharq College begins with specialized technical academic programs designed to equip students with the scientific knowledge and practical skills needed to meet local and regional labor market requirements.
programs.p2: Through modern curricula that integrate theoretical and applied aspects, the College provides a solid scientific foundation across its specializations, with a focus on developing analytical skills, scientific thinking, and professional practice, preparing students for successful academic and professional careers in their fields.

innovation.p: At Alsharq College, we believe that education is the engine of change and the gateway to innovation. We shape future leaders and inspire ambitious minds.
